name: Hound of Bristlebane
description: A young Shadowmoor kithkin woman who rode a springjack and drove a spear through a Dominus during the invasion.

timeline.summary: The Hound of Bristlebane skewers a Dominus with a spear along a branch of the Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: singlehandedly drove a spear through the body of a Dominus, skewering it from neck to knee

relations.quote: The Hound of Bristlebane, a young kithkin woman who rode a springjack mount into battle
